name: acceptance-e2e
description: Turn a feature's requirements + the running app into an acceptance-criteria-traceable Playwright suite in the project's own e2e harness — then go proactive: seven driven-and-asserted sweeps beyond the ACs (state-matrix forcing via interception, fault injection incl. offline/timeout/double-submit, interaction-integrity + reactivity, keyboard + axe a11y floor, data-shape stress over API-seeded edge fixtures, security surface incl. forged-action/IDOR/channel-authz, multi-user two-context realtime), a rendered-quality handoff that invokes the /design-review skill (deterministic WCAG/layout gates + judged craft/state/flow passes) and the mockup-fidelity layer where a design-of-record exists, surgical fixes for tractable bugs, and guard promotion — every sweep becomes a permanent CI/pre-push gate invoked by a named script, with new surfaces inheriting by enumeration. Coverage axes are enumerated and the sample declared up front; committed specs carry their run record. Lanes for native apps (Maestro deep-link-first, XCUITest, performAccessibilityAudit), MCP servers (acceptance = a real MCP client driving the built server), and marketing sites (route x viewport loads, link/heading/meta audits, claim-grounding invariants). v1.4.0 phases 0-9, from the portfolio QA plan + the WEB-4905 audit.
